turns.text: Task: In httpx/_auth.py, add a small Auth subclass BearerAuth(Auth) that takes token: str in __init__ and sets request.headers['Authorization'] = f'Bearer {self._token}' in auth_flow. Add unit tests for BearerAuth in tests/test_auth.py. Constraints: use only your file read and file edit tools, and the single shell command: py -3.11 -m pytest --noconftest -o filterwarnings=default -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_auth.py -q (run it at the end). Do not run any other shell command.
